body.cap: ITRI invites visitors to explore its tech exhibits at CES 2023 both physically and virtually.

body.x: The Industrial Technology Research Institute (ITRI), Taiwan’s leading high-tech applied research institution, holds its exhibits both online and offline. In CES 2023 booth 9855, North Hall, LVCC, and its virtual event site, ITRI will showcase its innovations in sports, fitness, AI, robotics, and ICT. ITRI will also present at CES Unveiled Las Vegas, booth 213, Level 2, Shoreline Exhibit Hall, Mandalay Bay Convention Center.

ITRI will highlight two new technologies in sports and fitness. iSportWeaR is a wearable device that monitors physiological data and provides health analysis and management during exercise. The Digital Twin for Sport Guidance with Vital Sign Sensing is the world’s first virtual coach for indoor bike and flywheel training. The digital twin utilizes contactless detection technology to provide advice on breathing, biomechanics, and coordination.

ITRI will also emphasize three new technologies in AI, robotics, and ICT. AI Aquarium is the world’s first smart aquarium that helps identify marine life in real time. It received a CES 2023 Innovation Awards honoree. Cubot ONE: Indoor/Outdoor AMR is an autonomous mobile robot (AMR) integrating AI, IoT, and 5G technologies. It can operate indoors and outdoors, take elevators and travel on the rugged ground. RobotSmith is a cyber-physical system for metal workpiece grinding and polishing. This system incorporates sensing, robotics, industry practices and software to offer a total solution for surface finishing.
